current_early_consumption_operations: BehindHeadString first-contact context armed at coordinate commit

coordinate_commit_contract.commit: atomically move and stop cue ball, retain matchState.ballInHand=true and the same non-None scope, increment one authority revision, stale the consumed decision, and stage exactly one fresh replacement Core-G offer for the same actor and scope
coordinate_commit_contract.ack: bind movement, authoritative cue-ball position, retained entitlement, placementPending=true, unchanged scope, and replacement decision identity/hash
coordinate_commit_contract.repeated_preview_and_confirm: ModernProductSession refreshes the replacement offer after ACK; any number of later valid coordinate preview/confirm cycles remain reachable
coordinate_commit_contract.exact_retry: return the original ACK without another move, revision increment, offer replacement, event, action, or receipt
coordinate_commit_contract.conflicting_retry: same key with changed actor/action/position/decision/revision/hash fails closed with zero authority delta
coordinate_commit_contract.behind_head_string_context: coordinate commits do not arm shot collection; retain enough frozen final-placement authority to arm the existing exact center-crossing context only in the later positive-impulse commit

positive_impulse_consumption_contract.entry: applyShot/applyCueImpact may evaluate a cue impact while exactly one current Core-G entitlement is live and no sibling rules decision is pending
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.actor: live offer actor must equal current match player; an unexpected turn change rejects and invalidates the stale entitlement without transfer
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.consume_if_and_only_if: the selected positive predicate succeeds on the candidate CueShotApplication
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.atomic_success: apply candidate cue-ball impulse, increment one authority revision, consume matchState ball-in-hand and scope, stale/clear the current placement offer, emit one consumption event/action, begin one shot collector, and for BehindHeadString arm the existing frozen final-position center-crossing context before collector begin
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.exactly_once: after successful consumption, balls-moving and absent-entitlement guards prevent a second consumption; one revision/event/action/collector begin is observable
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.later_physics_step_failure: does not undo an already successful authoritative positive-impulse launch commit; this is not a failed launch
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.failed_candidate: preserve cue position, entitlement, offer identity/hash, scope, authority revision, authority events/actions, placement receipts, and inactive shot collector
positive_impulse_consumption_contract.reset_or_match_completion: invalidate entitlement and offer fail closed
